# A2UI basic catalog examples

Copied unchanged from [a2ui-project/a2ui](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui) at commit `a23b19c4f2102695c506adb7d1ded1f5f81a7688`:
`catalogs/basic/v1/examples` into `v1/` and `catalogs/basic/v0_9_1/examples` into `v0_9_1/`.
They are Copyright Google LLC and licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (`LICENSE` here).

`conformance.test.tsx` replays each one through this package and expects it to render with no protocol error and
no component outside the basic catalog. To update them, copy the same directories from a newer commit and change
the commit above.
